review.tagline: Jupyter notebooks of copy-able Claude API recipes in Python
review.summary: Anthropic's collection of runnable notebooks and guides for building with the Claude API. Recipes cover classification, RAG, summarization, tool use, vision, sub-agents, JSON mode, prompt caching, evals and cost optimization. Examples are mainly Python, and a Claude API key is required.
review.audience: Developers learning to build applications on the Claude API
strengths: Covers tool use, RAG, vision, prompt caching and evals with runnable notebooks
Maintained by Anthropic, so examples target the Claude API directly
MIT licensed, snippets can be copied into your own projects
Includes third-party recipes such as Pinecone, Voyage AI embeddings and Wikipedia search
weaknesses: Requires a Claude API key; examples do not run on local models
Examples are primarily Python; other languages must be adapted
Recipe links in the README point to the older anthropic-cookbook repo path
Reference snippets, not an installable library or application
needs: Needs Claude API key, Pinecone (some recipes), Voyage AI (some recipes)
